title: Your Webb County Week Ahead: A Hot Start, Then a Cooler, Wetter Weekend
excerpt: Your Webb County week ahead: a hot 92-degree Monday, a cooler and wetter weekend, and no weather alerts.
content:
LAREDO — Here is your Webb County week ahead: a hot start, then a cooler, wetter finish — and no weather alerts in effect.

Monday is the hottest day, morning clouds giving way to afternoon sun, high near 92, low near 74. Tuesday cools to 85, low near 61, with morning clouds and afternoon sun. Wednesday is sunny, high near 84, low near 66.

Thursday is mostly cloudy, high near 86, low near 70, with showers late and a 30 percent rain chance overnight. Friday is partly cloudy, high near 82, low near 65, with showers late and a 60 percent rain chance overnight. Saturday is the wettest and coolest day, with showers, high near 76, low near 61, and a 60 percent rain chance.

Sunday dries out a bit, partly cloudy, high near 77, low near 55 — the week's coolest night. Rain chances are 20 percent or less most days, except Thursday night through Saturday. Winds stay light to moderate, 6 to 13 mph, shifting from the south early in the week to the north by the weekend. No weather alerts are in effect for Webb County.

Bottom line: enjoy the warm start, then keep an umbrella handy Friday night into Saturday. Stay cool out there, Webb County.
